# Code Anchors: Citation Check

- `libs/scope-razor/src/citations.ts` — the label grammar, the shared normalization, the four-word floor, and the containment test.
- `libs/scope-razor/src/citations.spec.ts` — pins the normalization slack, the word floor, and that a fragment absent from the source text fails.
- `libs/scope-razor/src/check.ts` — runs the comparison over every labelled item and every labelled story heading against the materialized source copy.
- `components/skills/nxs-razor/SKILL.md` — the per-mode table of what the source text is, and why it is materialized once rather than re-read.
- `components/commands/nxs.epic.md` — materializes the run's source text into session scratch before labelling anything, and renders each story's fragment verbatim at the gate.
- `components/commands/nxs.decision-record.md` — the same materialization over a record's invariants and risks.
- `components/commands/nxs.discover.md` — the same over a discovery document and its tickets, with resolutions exempt.
